sources_confirmed_before_plan.scope: Actual existing running user-unit pattern omits explicit User; full source text saved here.
sources_confirmed_before_plan.source_text:
[Unit]
Description=Campaign5 fully mobile stationary Ni/H structures
Wants=dft-c5-checkpoint-commits.service
After=dft-c5-checkpoint-commits.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=3600
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Type=exec
WorkingDirectory=/home/administrator/projects/catalyst-collective
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/home/administrator/projects/catalyst-collective/src
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
ExecStart=/home/administrator/projects/catalyst-dft/.venv/bin/python -u -m catdft.job_queue --manifest /home/administrator/projects/catalyst-collective/runs/2026-10-19_collective-response/material/manifest.json
ExecStopPost=-/home/administrator/projects/catalyst-dft/.venv/bin/python /home/administrator/projects/catalyst-collective/runs/2026-10-19_collective-response/notify_exit.py --unit=%n
Restart=on-failure
RestartPreventExitStatus=2
RestartSec=30
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=60
AllowedCPUs=0-4
MemoryMax=12G
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
